description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Witch Mode I: Shantotto] and [Witch Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Witch Mode I: Shantotto
description.text: Witch abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Witch abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Spark after casting the first Witch ability under the status

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Witch Mode II: Shantotto] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Witch Mode I: Shantotto] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Witch Mode II: Shantotto
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Witch abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Quick Cast 1] and [Witch +30% Boost 1] to the user after using Witch abilities

description.name: Dual Spark
description.text: One single attack (5.64) capped at 99999, grants [Instant Cast 3] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
